translation: We all met back up with Haruhi once again.

…So in the end, nobody was able to get any
conclusive data?

Haruhi said—looking like she was sitting at
120% on the discomfort index.

Incidentally, that "nobody” includes you too,
Haruhi.

What were you all doing?! This just isn't good
enough! The SOS Brigade is better than this!

Haruhi appeared to be angry that we hadn't
produced any significant results.

But hey, it's not like I don't understand how
she feels.

It's true that we weren't able to get any new
leads or information at all.

I wanted to find something that might
dissuade Haruhi somehow…

To tell the truth, it's not like we came up
completely empty-handed…

But the info we scrounged up can only go so
far as convincing her that the rumor is fake.

Furthermore… I'm not sure where or when to
even bring those things up.

Geez! Why won't you show up already?! Reveal
yourself, man-eating classroom!

Don't go kicking all the walls just because the
phenomenon you're looking for won't show up.

Why not? There could be a hidden door
somewhere, right?
So I'm simply investigating!

From my perspective, it just looks like she's
taking out her frustration on the walls.

Don't be shy! I'll give you to the count of
three…! Two…! One…! Go!

Haruhi's kicks were so aggressive, they left
a clear imprint from her indoor shoes.
…I don't like where this is going.

Same here. I'm just praying she doesn't cause
any property damage.

No, that's not what I mean—I'm referring to
Miss Suzumiya's emotional state.

Don't tell me you've forgotten? When
frustration builds up within her…

Closed space or whatever starts bubbling
up—putting the whole world in danger, right.

Indeed. I'm sure you recall the figure of those
"Celestials.”

To be honest, I wish I could forget. Memories
can be troublesome things.
…Is that how critical things have gotten?

Most likely, yes. But if you're looking for a
concrete analysis, I'm afraid I can't provide.

Which means… there's only one person here
who's able to accurately grasp the situation.
What's the status, Nagato?

The space is proceeding to further
destabilize.
…We must quickly respond.

Even if we need to hurry, it's too tricky in this
situation.
I have no idea what we should—
What? What are you talking about?
Haruhi suddenly stuck her nose in.

We're discussing who's gonna wipe clean the
wall you stamped your dirt onto.

Well that's boring. Talk about something more
constructive.

Like, how to get the man-eating classroom to
appear. Maybe you need a living sacrifice!
She said something terrifying again.

That's right, you probably need a human
sacrifice.
And only beautiful girls get swallowed up!

Saying so, Haruhi's gaze turned toward
Asahina. Whoa whoa whoa…

[#SK0Wh]-what is it? Wh-wh-why are you looking at
meee?!

Yep, Mikuru is more than good enough to be
an exceptional sacrifice.
Huhhhhh?! S-sacrifice?!
Or maybe we could use Kyon's little sister.
Ooh, what? Is something up?

Don't elect my little sister as a sacrifice like
you own her.

For one thing, the computer society member
who claimed to witness it is a guy.

I've never heard of any beautiful girls in the
Computer Research Society.

That's why he didn't get sacrificed. He's lucky
he was only a witness.

Mikuru, little sister—come over here for a
second.
Okay, sure~!
A-are you sure it's just for a second…?
Whoa whoa, is this okay…?

If Haruhi is dead set on an idea, it's not
uncommon for it to become reality. Dangerous.

We have to convince Haruhi that class 1-10
doesn't exist by any means necessary…

At this point, should I just try and fool her
with some random made-up story?

"Those guys've been exhausted from pulling
all-nighters—they were just seeing things!”

…It would be far too easy if all it took was
something like that.

At this point, would it satisfy her to hear
about the aforementioned poster situation?

This is Haruhi, so she'd still probably be a little
dissatisfied, but at least it might convince her.

Should I tell her about the plate with the
class name written on it?

If I say that it was all just someone's prank,
she might be able to begrudgingly accept it.

Well, there's nothing to gain from sitting here
worrying about it, so I'll just give it a shot.

I'll tell her that 1-10 doesn't exist—that it's
all just a big misunderstanding…
Hey, Haruhi—
Just a moment, please.

Koizumi stopped me with his arm as I began to
call out. …What is it all of a sudden?
It would be wise for you to reconsider.
What?

Persuading her with words is not a viable
strategy right now.
If not now, then when?
I don't think it's a matter of timing.
Most likely, Miss Suzumiya—
Hm? You need me for something, Koizumi?
Did you find a lead?
Bad timing. Haruhi's back.

The sacrifice strategy is no good after
all—we have to think of some other method.

Like breaking the wall with a pickaxe or
something…

Her suggestions have only gotten more
absurd.

Seriously, those computer society guys
weren't just lying to us, were they?

Based on their behavior, they certainly didn't
look like they were lying.

But that's just because they're terrified of
Haruhi. We have history with them after all…
[#SK0E]-eeeeh~

That's right. Their club president was
trembling with fear just like my little sist…
Wha—hey, what's wrong?
[#SK0Uhhh]… Kyon, I have to go to the bathroooom.
Wh-whaat?!

I may be your big brother, but I don't know
what to do if you say that all of a sudden.

You're asking me to accompany you to the
uncharted territory of the women's restroom?
[#SK0I]'ve been holding it in for sooooo long.
[#SK0Baaaathrooooom]~~~
I get it, just hold it for a little longer—
[#SK0Aaaaaah], I can't hold it!

Looks like we've got no choice then. I'll take
you there.

I don't suppose you know where the
bathrooms are, huh? C'mon, I'll go with you.
Haruhi…?

I'm gonna have a go at the computer society
while we're at it.
Okay, let's go, little sister.
Yup!
Haruhi left with my sister.
[#SK0Pheeeew][#sk], that was scaryyy.

Leaving behind Asahina, who was nearly
offered as a sacrifice earlier.
About Haruhi
